Devin Booker scored the Suns' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 16 times in 70 starts, or 23% of the games they started. Dillon Brooks was next with 15. The Suns made the game's first field goal in 55% of their 88 games and won 71% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
